content.title: National Weather Service
content.text: TonightIsolated showers after midnight. Mostly clear, with a low around 71. Northeast wind around 5 mph becoming light and variable in the evening. Chance of precipitation is 10%.ThursdayScattered showers, mainly after noon. Mostly sunny, with a high near 87. Light and variable wind becoming east northeast 6 to 11 mph in the morning. Chance of precipitation is 30%.Thursday NightIsolated showers. Mostly clear, with a low around 71. East wind 5 to 7 mph becoming south southeast after midnight. Chance of precipitation is 20%.FridayScattered showers, mainly after noon. Mostly sunny, with a high near 87. Light southeast wind becoming east 5 to 9 mph in the morning. Chance of precipitation is 40%.Friday NightIsolated showers. Partly cloudy, with a low around 72. South southeast wind 5 to 7 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.SaturdayIsolated showers, then showers likely and possibly a thunderstorm after noon. Partly sunny, with a high near 88. South southeast wind 6 to 9 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%.Saturday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 73. Calm wind becoming south around 5 mph after midnight. SundayShowers likely after noon. Mostly sunny, with a high near 89. Light south southeast wind becoming east 5 to 9 mph in the morning. Chance of precipitation is 60%.Sunday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 73. South southeast wind 3 to 6 mph. MondayShowers likely, mainly after noon. Partly sunny, with a high near 88. Chance of precipitation is 60%.Monday NightScattered showers. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 74. Chance of precipitation is 50%.TuesdayScattered showers. Partly sunny, with a high near 88. Chance of precipitation is 50%.Tuesday NightScattered showers.
